回溯天数改为手动输入: Lookback days are now entered manually

密度只调整字体大小，不改变页面结构。: Density only adjusts font size and does not change the page layout.

微调软件图标，新增图标配色：跟随主题或手动指定: Refined the app icon and added icon coloring: follow theme or set manually
手动配色只在桌面图标上生效，不影响界面色调。: Manual coloring applies only to the launcher icon and does not affect the interface color tone.

报表日期默认折叠，点击对应的行展开滚轮选择。: Report dates are collapsed by default; tap the corresponding row to expand the wheel picker.

新增「自动去重」：按精确金额、时间与支出去向核验银行卡短信与支付宝通知，减少重复: New "Auto dedupe": verifies bank card SMS against Alipay notifications by exact amount, time, and payment destination to reduce duplicate entries; choose Auto-merge (beta) / Ask every time / Off
新增手动日间 / 夜间模式切换: Added a manual Light / Dark mode switch
新增樱花粉与黑白色调: Added Sakura pink and Monochrome color tones
无障碍读取增加等待延迟，默认 5 秒，可在设置中调整: Accessibility reading now has a wait delay, 5 seconds by default, adjustable in settings
明细页显示收入来源 / 支出去向: The details page shows income source / payment destination
权限：短信读取只解析你指定号码发来的银行短信；通知使用权只解析你在“动账信源”里: Permissions: SMS access parses only bank SMS from the numbers you specify; notification access parses only the apps you select in "Transaction sources";
每次询问：发现疑似重复时两笔都保留，并在首页逐条询问“合并 / 保留两笔”。: Ask every time: when suspected duplicates are found, both records are kept and you are asked one by one on the home page to "Merge / Keep both".
没有可列出的应用：可能仍在读取，或系统不允许读取已安装应用: No apps to list: they may still be loading, or the system does not allow reading installed apps
滚轮选择周报在星期几生成（生成上一自然周）。: Use the wheel to choose which weekday the weekly report is generated (covers the previous calendar week).
滚轮选择年报的月份与日期（1 至 28 日）。: Use the wheel to choose the month and day of the yearly report (1 to 28).
滚轮选择每月哪一天生成上月月报（只提供 1 至 28 日，保证每月都能触发）。: Use the wheel to choose which day of the month the previous month's report is generated (only 1 to 28, so it triggers every month).
离线：本应用不申请网络权限，没有任何联网能力；流水、账户与报表只保存在本机数据库: Offline: this app does not request network permission and has no network capability; transactions, accounts, and reports are stored only in the local database,

设置页新增「当前版本」与「关于自动记账」，点击版本可查看更新日志: Added "Current version" and "About Auto Ledger" to the settings page; tap the version to view the changelog
